exposure: Morphine (100 µg) added to bupivacaine for spinal anesthesia
Fentanyl (25 µg) added to bupivacaine for spinal anesthesia
cohort: 190 patients undergoing elective cesarean section under spinal anesthesia
finding: Patients who received morphine for spinal anesthesia had significantly better pain management and higher levels of satisfaction compared to those who received fentanyl, although fentanyl was associated with fewer side effects.
